snippet.title: Voidwood Announcement Trailer | Co-op Survival Horror Where Your Voice Draws Danger
snippet.description:
By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive it.

Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game where your voice can save your friends or lead the hunt straight to them. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694420/Voidwood/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=announce_aug2026

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/HpTEJxahvb

Website: https://www.voidwood.com

Coming to Steam in 2027.

X / Twitter: https://x.com/VoidwoodGame
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@voidwoodgame
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voidwoodgame
